[P1] 作者马克斯·维尔修思是一位备受国际推崇的儿童插画家
本套图书曾获荷兰 Golden Pencil 大奖、法国 Prix de Trelize 大奖
德国 Bestlist Award 大奖、美国 Graphic Award 大奖

“故事惊人地简单，充满了乐观向上的精神和对生命的尊重，是一本完美的儿童
图画书。”
—— 美国《童书商报》

这是一套有助于孩子心灵成长的心理教育故事。每个故事都自然流露出某
种重要的主题，充满了想象力。文图都是马克斯·维尔修思创作的，文字透着
生动和浅浅的幽默，图画则是鲜有的简笔风格，被西方艺术家誉为“简笔画
世界的杰作”。目前该系列已经被翻译成38种语言，全球销量逾百万册。

ISBN 7-5358-3059-5

ISBN 7-5358-3059-5/1·734
定价:4.80 元

青蛙弗洛格的成长故事
为处在性格形成关键期（3-6岁）
的孩子准备的一份心理自助礼物

图·文／（荷）马克斯·维尔修思
鸟儿在歌唱
—— 学会珍爱生命 ——

湖南少年儿童出版社

[P2] 荣获
国际安徒生
插图奖
青蛙弗洛格的成长故事
图·文／（荷）马克斯·维尔修思
鸟儿在歌唱
—— 学会珍爱生命 ——
湖南少年儿童出版社
HUNAN JUVENILE & CHILDREN'S PUBLISHING HOUSE

[P3] 那是一个美丽的秋天，小猪在果园里摘熟透的苹果……
青蛙弗洛格朝他走过来，看起来很忧愁。

[P4] “我发现了一样东西。”他说。“什么东西？”小猪问。
“跟我来，我带你去看。”弗洛格回答。

[P5] 他们一起出发了，小猪觉得有点紧张。

当他们来到一块空地时，弗洛格用手指着地上说：“你看，这只黑鸟有些不对劲，他一动也不动。”

[P6] tā kě néng shuì zháo le  xiǎo zhū shuō
“他可能睡着了。”小猪说。
zè shí hou xiǎo yā shān zhe chì bǎng pǎo lái le
这时候小鸭扇着翅膀跑来了。

[P7] “怎么了？”她很关心，“发生了什么意外？”“嘘！他睡着了。”弗洛格说。但小鸭觉得这鸟儿看起来像是生病了。
这时，野兔正啃着红萝卜从树林里出来，远远看到这边有什么事情发生，也加入了进来。

[P8] 他蹲下来看了看躺在地上的鸟儿，说：“他死了。”“死了？”弗洛格问，“什么是死？”

野兔用手指了指蓝色的天空。“所有东西都会死。”他说。“我们也一样吗？”弗洛格又问。野兔不太能确定。“也许吧！等我们老了以后。”他说。

[P9] 他们一起做了个担架，抬着鸟儿向山丘下的草地走去。

“我们应该把他埋了，”野兔指着不远的地方说，“就埋在那山丘底下。”

[P10] 他们在地上挖了一个很深的洞。
野兔在一旁轻轻地 说：“鸟儿一生都在用
优美的声音为我们唱歌，他现在可以安息了。”

[P11] 大家小心翼翼地将鸟儿放入小洞里。弗洛格还在上面撒了些他找来的野花。小猪流着眼泪用泥土把洞口盖上。

最后，他们还搬来了一块美丽的石头放在上面。整个仪式显得十分安详，四周也非常安静，连鸟儿的叫声都没有。

[P12] 大家很感动，在回去的路上静静地都没说话。

突然弗洛格跑到大家前面兴奋地大叫：“我们来玩‘官兵捉强盗’的游戏！小猪，你来抓我吧。”

[P13] tā men yòu nào yòu xiào  yí zhí wán dào tiān hēi
他们又闹又笑，一直玩到天黑。
shēng mìng zhēn měi hǎo  duì ba  qīng wā dà shēng shuō
“生命真美好！对吧？”青蛙大声说。

[P14] 学会珍爱生命

每个人的生命都只有一次，所以我们要珍惜生命、尊重生命，
让每一天都过得充实、美好！

想一想
1. 躺在地上的黑鸟怎么了？
2. 弗洛格和伙伴们是怎样对待那只黑鸟的？
3. 最后，弗洛格发出了怎样的感叹？

试一试
跟爸爸妈妈讨论一下“珍惜生命、热爱生命”的话题，
说说你的想法。

这群玩累了的朋友高兴地走在回家的路上。当他们经过山脚下时，一只黑鸟如往常一样在树上唱着美妙的歌。
full_text_en:
[P1] Author Max Velthuijs is a children's illustrator highly acclaimed internationally.
This series has won the Dutch Golden Pencil Award, the French Prix de Trelize Award,
the German Bestlist Award, and the American Graphic Award.

"The story is remarkably simple, full of optimistic spirit and respect for life, a perfect children's picture book."
— American 'Booklist for Children'

This is a series of psychological education stories that help children's mental growth. Each story naturally reveals an important theme, full of imagination. Both text and illustrations are created by Max Velthuijs. The text is lively and subtly humorous, while the illustrations feature a rare simple style, hailed by Western artists as 'a masterpiece of simple line drawing'. This series has been translated into 38 languages and has sold over one million copies worldwide.

ISBN 7-5358-3059-5

ISBN 7-5358-3059-5/1·734
Price: 4.80 RMB

Froggy's Growth Stories
A psychological self-help gift for children in the critical period of personality development (ages 3-6)

Illustrations & Text / (Netherlands) Max Velthuijs
Birds Are Singing
— Learning to Cherish Life —

Hunan Children's Publishing House

[P2] Awarded
International Andersen
Illustration Prize
Froggy's Growth Stories
Illustrations & Text / (Netherlands) Max Velthuijs
Birds Are Singing
—— Learning to Cherish Life ——
Hunan Juvenile & Children's Publishing House
HUNAN JUVENILE & CHILDREN'S PUBLISHING HOUSE

[P3] It was a beautiful autumn day. The little pig was picking ripe apples in the orchard...
Frog Floppy came over to him, looking very worried.

[P4] "I found something," he said. "What is it?" asked the little pig.
"Come with me, I'll show you," answered Frog.

[P5] They set off together. The little pig felt a bit nervous.

When they arrived at an empty patch, Frog pointed to the ground and said, "Look, this black bird seems off. It's not moving at all."

[P6] tā kě néng shuì zháo le  xiǎo zhū shuō
"He might be asleep," said the little pig.
zè shí hou xiǎo yā shān zhe chì bǎng pǎo lái le
At this moment, the little duck flapped his wings and ran over.

[P7] "What's wrong?" she asked, concerned. "What's happening?" "Shh! He's asleep," said Frog. But Duck thought the bird looked sick.
At that moment, Rabbit, munching on a carrot, came out of the woods. Seeing something happening over there, he also came over.

[P8] He crouched down and looked at the bird lying on the ground. "It's dead," he said. "Dead?" asked Frog. "What is dead?"

The rabbit pointed to the blue sky. "Everything dies," he said. "Will we too?" asked Frog again. The rabbit wasn't sure. "Maybe! When we get old," he said.

[P9] They made a stretcher together and carried the bird toward the grassy area below the hill.

“We should bury him,” said the rabbit, pointing to a spot not far away, “right at the foot of that hill.”

[P10] They dug a very deep hole in the ground.
Rabbit said softly beside them: "The bird has always sung beautiful songs for us. Now he can rest in peace."

[P11] Everyone carefully placed the bird into the small hole. Frog sprinkled some wildflowers he had found on top. Piggy wiped away tears as he covered the hole with soil.

Finally, they brought a beautiful stone and placed it on top. The whole ceremony was very peaceful, and everything around was quiet—there was not even a bird's call.

[P12] Everyone was very moved, and on the way back, they didn't speak a word.

Suddenly, Frog ran up to everyone, excitedly shouting, "Let's play 'Cops and Robbers'! Pig, you come catch me!"

[P13] tā men yòu nào yòu xiào  yí zhí wán dào tiān hēi
They laughed and played, all the way until it got dark.
shēng mìng zhēn měi hǎo  duì ba  qīng wā dà shēng shuō
"Life is truly wonderful, isn't it?" the frog said loudly.

[P14] Learn to Cherish Life

Each person's life has only one chance, so we must cherish and respect life,
and make every day fulfilling and beautiful!

Think About It
1. What happened to the black bird lying on the ground?
2. How did Frog and his friends treat the black bird?
3. What final reflection did Frog share?

Try This
Talk with your parents about the topic of "cherishing and loving life",
and share your thoughts.

The group of friends, tired from playing, happily walked home. As they passed by the foot of the hill, a black bird, as usual, was singing a beautiful song in the tree.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《鸟儿在歌唱》的封面及封底，介绍了作者马克斯·维尔修思、图书获奖情况、系列主题及出版信息，强调其为3-6岁儿童的心理成长提供帮助。
[P2] 本页为绘本《鸟儿在歌唱》的扉页，展示了书名、作者信息、主题副标题及出版社，同时配有青蛙弗洛格的插图，强调该书属于‘青蛙弗洛格的成长故事’系列，旨在帮助儿童学会珍爱生命。
[P3] 在一个美丽的秋天，小猪正在果园里爬梯子摘苹果，青蛙弗洛格走过来，看起来很忧愁。
[P4] 弗洛格告诉小猪他发现了一样东西，邀请小猪跟他一起去看看。
[P5] 小猪和弗洛格一起出发，来到一块空地，弗洛格发现一只一动不动的黑鸟，显得很不对劲。
[P6] 小猪和弗洛格发现一只一动不动的黑鸟，小猪猜测它可能睡着了，这时小鸭扇着翅膀跑过来。
[P7] 小猪、弗洛格和小鸭发现一只一动不动的黑鸟，弗洛格认为它在睡觉，但小鸭觉得它可能生病了。与此同时，野兔啃着红萝卜从树林里出来，也加入了他们。
[P8] 小猪、弗洛格、小鸭和野兔围在一只不动的黑鸟旁，野兔解释死亡是所有生命都会经历的自然过程，并推测他们也会在年老后死去。
[P9] 小猪、弗洛格、小鸭和野兔一起为死去的鸟儿做了担架，并决定将其埋葬在山丘下的草地上。
[P10] 小猪、弗洛格、小鸭和野兔正在为死去的鸟儿挖一个深洞，准备将其埋葬。野兔在一旁轻声说道，鸟儿一生都在用优美的歌声陪伴大家，现在可以安息了。
[P11] 小猪、弗洛格、小鸭和野兔将死去的鸟儿安葬在山丘下的草地上，他们用泥土盖住洞口，撒上野花，并放上一块石头作为标记，整个过程庄重而安静。
[P12] 小猪、弗洛格、小鸭和野兔安葬完黑鸟后，在回去的路上沉默不语，气氛庄重。突然，弗洛格兴奋地提议玩“官兵捉强盗”的游戏，打破了寂静。
[P13] 小猪、弗洛格、小鸭和野兔在安葬黑鸟后，开心地玩耍，一直玩到天黑，青蛙感叹生命美好。
[P14] 本页为绘本的结尾部分，左侧图画展示朋友们回家路上看到黑鸟在树上歌唱，右侧文字总结了珍惜生命的主题，并提出思考题和亲子讨论建议，呼应前文对生命与死亡的探讨。
